theme_central: The Qur'an sent down during a blessed night (the Night of Decree); between the smoke announced as punishment and Pharaoh's fate, the same question: believe before it is too late.
sources_note: 3-section structure precisely sourced (thelastdialogue.org): Pharaoh drowned, certainty of the Judgment, reward of the pious.

branches.title: Opening, the blessed Night
branches.resume: The Qur'an sent down during a blessed night; warning to those who doubt.

branches.title: The announced smoke
branches.resume: Source of the surah's name: a visible smoke announced as punishment, temporary relief promised.
